ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups in robots.txt for other training crawlers (Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, etc.) while keeping search bots allowed
ideas.why: geo.config.json says trainingCrawlers: block but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the stated policy is only partly enforced.

ideas.idea: Add Bakery/LocalBusiness JSON-LD on the home page
ideas.why: The brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, so recommending it as a fix goes against that.

ideas.idea: Add ItemList/Product markup on breads, Course/Event on classes, BreadcrumbList on inner pages
ideas.why: This is more structured-data advice, and the brief says JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add visible address, hours, phone and contact details in a footer
ideas.why: No page states where the bakery is or when it opens, so people and machines can't get those facts from the site.

ideas.idea: Explain how to pre-order on the home page with a link or form
ideas.why: index.html says 'Pre-order for weekend collection' but gives no way to do it.

ideas.idea: List every loaf with grain, flavour and price on breads.html
ideas.why: The page says 'over twenty loaves' but names only two, so the specific content is missing.

ideas.idea: Add dates, duration, price, group size and a booking link to classes.html
ideas.why: The page says 'Book early' but gives no details or way to book.

ideas.idea: Make the home page copy specific by naming grains, fermentation time and the bakery's story
ideas.why: The copy 'wide range of loaves from heritage grains' is vague and names nothing.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the allergen text, or confirm it is deliberate
ideas.why: The data-nosnippet on the allergen notice is a deliberate scoped choice, so this pushes against it.

ideas.idea: Remove the robots.txt Disallow for /members/ and keep noindex
ideas.why: The brief says noindex plus disallow on the private members page is correct and deliberate.

ideas.idea: Add og:title, og:description, og:image and twitter:card tags
ideas.why: Accurate, since none are present, but it is standard advice that applies to almost any site and mainly affects link previews.
Accurate, but it is standard advice with a small effect on a three-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Check that /img/loaves.jpg exists and add width and height attributes
ideas.why: This is standard image hygiene that applies to any site, and the width and height attributes have little effect here.

ideas.idea: Add photos of the breads to the pages
ideas.why: This is generic content advice, though breads.html does have no images.

ideas.idea: Add a footer and breadcrumbs for navigation
ideas.why: This is generic navigation advice, and the site has only three pages.
The brief says having no llms.txt is not a problem, and llms.txt does not help a site get found.

ideas.idea: Switch to clean URLs without .html, updating canonicals and sitemap
ideas.why: This is cosmetic advice that applies to almost any site and has very little effect on discovery.
